document.about: US Census Bureau P60-287, Poverty in the United States: 2024. Some continued tables' titles carry a `—Con.` that a white box, a little shorter than the type, is laid over.

notes: 2026-11-27: a box 9.6pt tall over 10pt type was read as a rule over the mark it lies on, and hid nothing. A bar hides nothing only when it is under half the type's size. Where the box stops 0.35pt short of the dash, a sliver of the dash shows, and the title keeps its `—Con.`.

checks.issue: `—Con.` under a box over the title read on both continued pages of the measures table; only the page whose box falls short of the dash shows any of it.
